question: How should the image of Caṇḍa be ritually bathed?
premises: Various waters are prepared in pots
These waters serve as bathing substances
The Caṇḍa image is the object of bathing
inference: The officiant should bathe the image of Caṇḍa with the various waters contained in pots.
plain_english: One should bathe the image of Caṇḍa with the various waters placed in pots.
